scope: Finite synchronous two-layer content network, not a task-benefit experiment
source_freeze: Local Git commit before study execution; publication is separate
training_check: Final same-input MSE <= 0.2 times initial MSE; failure is retained
cold_check: Warm and fresh-process forward continuations from full saved state have equal tensor bytes
semantic_limits: One interval of causal interlayer latency
Shared physics and probability across batch
No gradient through cold checkpoint history
No continuum or arbitrary time-partition equivalence
No claim of task-optimality or real-task advantage
